Wolfram's Dimensions counts the arguments of any head, so the unevaluated call has dimensions {1}; Shape of a call that isn't a tensor is the empty tuple.

our AdjacencyMatrix(Graph({},{})) answers the empty list (a well-defined 0x0 adjacency matrix for a vertexless graph); Wolfram's own AdjacencyMatrix[Graph[{},{}]] stays unevaluated in the scan (a genuinely degenerate/vertexless Graph construction convention on Wolfram's side, not a shared definition). Both defensible under their own convention.
